summary: This directory manages the formatting and generation of JSDoc documentation components. It encapsulates the logic required to transform internal code structures into human-readable documentation strings compatible with JSDoc standards.
responsibilities: Translate internal metadata into JSDoc syntax
Ensure consistent documentation output across the codebase
relationships: The rendering engine processes code metadata to produce standardized JSDoc output.
Documentation components rely on defined formatting rules to maintain structure.
designDecisions: Separation of rendering concerns from code analysis logic
